data: What is the range of the x-axis values on the leftmost plot when the w(t)=10?

The caption states that the maximum value of w(t) is 10. From the leftmost plot, we can see that the x-axis represents time. When w(t) = 10, the corresponding x-axis value is approximately 2000. Therefore, the range of the x-axis values on the leftmost plot when w(t) = 10 is approximately 0 to 2000.
